I am a young farmer in Mzuzu with only a small piece of land behind our house, so I must make every corner count. I will buy a small amount of fertilizer from the market — maybe half a basin of NPK and some urea — because my household did not get the FISP coupon this year, but I still want a decent maize harvest to feed my family. I will plant hybrid maize seed that I kept from last season, mixed with some beans between the rows like we always do, and I will depend on the rains since we have no pump or treadle here.
